My travels / Mexico / Oaxaca

Mexico · two slow weeks

Two weeks
in Oaxaca

Día de Muertos, smoky markets, mezcal and two day trips, with plenty of empty days.

We’re in Oaxaca from Thursday 29 October to Thursday 12 November 2026, arriving by bus from Mexico City and leaving for Puerto Escondido. We travel very slowly: one thing a day, and days with nothing in them are fine.

Día de Muertos

The reason we timed it this way. Altars, parades and candlelit cemeteries, at an unhurried pace: one big thing a day, and lots of sitting in squares watching it all.

Food bucket list

From our wishlist. A bite counts as a tick.

Book ahead

The Xoxocotlán cemetery tour or shuttle for the night of 2 November, the Jardín Etnobotánico tour, the cooking class and the Mezcaloteca tasting. Hierve el Agua sometimes closes without warning because of local community disputes: check it’s open the week before you go.

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider donating to Red Nacional de Refugios to support women and children experiencing domestic violence.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
